{{Top|leg}}
'''Microgravity''' was the state where G-forces were not quite zero, just very small.<ref name="RD">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream]]''</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], microgravity was used to operate [[grav tube]]s aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]] such as [[M-Class Imperial Attack Transport]]s. Adjust the microgravity controls on the tube would allow individuals to float up or down the tube to different decks within the vessel.<ref name="Regina">{{WEGCite|story=Regina Cayli (adventure)|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref> During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], while on approach to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Borealis]], [[Jagged Fel]] felt the microgravity was perceptibly accelerating.<ref name="RD" />
